core_obligations: Define phi on B and extend it to the GWA generators (proof line 622).
Verify the four relations eq:GWA-rels2 by full computation (proof lines 623-651).
Reduce eq:GWA-rels1 to the generator cases and verify them, H cases from the presentation relations and t_i cases via the pf-phi computation (proof lines 653-676).
Conclude the sigma commutation via the domain corollary and the bijectivity of phi via the monomial basis (proof lines 678-685).
proof_roadmap: Definition and extension of phi (proof line 622).
difficulty_reason: 保留整条研究链为H2：330-396用根权序和extremal projector构造PBW三角基，398-494导出完整reduction关系，526-594选择归一化生成元及skew-affine自同构，621-686核实GWA关系并利用domain消去得到两自同构可交换及基的双射。难点是从double-coset reduction结构识别新的skew-affine GWA，而非仅给定公式后的代入。
